title: The ARIC MRI Study
brief_summary: To perform a follow-up study of cerebrovascular disease in the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities (ARIC) magnetic resonance imaging subcohort.
raw_criteria: Participated in the baseline ARIC MRI study.
study_population: Participants in the ARIC Neurocognitive Longitudinal Study were recruited for a follow-up brain MR scan and cognitive testing from the subset of the (parent) ARIC cohort that had an initial MR scan at the third (Visit 3) ARIC examination. Participants included black and white men and women.
